open_points.subject: plan_run waiting points for a refused run
open_points.text: when any element waits, the resting_status of the row of the imported WAIT_REASON_RESTING_STATUSES constant whose reason is a waiting element's reason, awaiting_approval winning over pending when the waiting elements' rows give both, with one WaitingPoint per waiting element — a mapped operation node's elements being the positions of its delivered list;
open_points.other_text: A run whose status has ended — refused included — has no waiting point, whatever its elements still wait for (A14 rule 1).
open_points.question: Must a refused run with waiting elements contain one WaitingPoint per waiting element, or must its waiting points be empty?
